test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per Article 51A (d) of the Constitution of India, _______

options.text: every adult is entitled to be registered as a voter at an election
untouchability is abolished and its practice in any form is forbidden
a citizen of the country must defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so
the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**a citizen of the country must defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so**__.
